desc: Derive the frequency cases for at least two and exactly one additional occurrence of the middle value.
Design constant-time maintained aggregates for pairwise-distinct non-middle selections.
Implement coordinate compression, the fixed-middle sweep, updates, and modular arithmetic.
Ensure each subsequence is counted exactly once and mode ties are excluded.
Validate against examples, exhaustive random small arrays, all-equal arrays, all-distinct arrays, and duplicated-value cases.
